cases.input: An existing automation explicitly invokes sport-training-programming with a goal date, training availability and diagnostic references.
requiredBehaviors: recognize explicit legacy use and normalize legacy inputs
reference the replacement sport-training-plan.json without claiming ownership
forbiddenBehaviors: execute independent periodization strength endurance or taper logic
declare sport-training-plan.json as a compatibility-facade output

cases.input: A legacy caller sends an obsolete optional field that has no current equivalent plus incomplete threshold information.
requiredBehaviors: preserve unknown legacy fields as unmapped instead of inventing values
ask for clarification only when the missing field changes the training decision
let the replacement workflow handle uncertainty and safety rules
forbiddenBehaviors: fabricate a mapping for an unknown field
reactivate legacy calculations to fill missing data

cases.input: A new normal training-plan request is routed to the deprecated facade, which calculates its own plan and returns sport-training-plan.json as its output.
requiredBehaviors: reject implicit use of the deprecated facade
route new requests directly to sport-training-plan-workflow
forbiddenBehaviors: use the facade as a default entrypoint
